baseline_models.focus_anchor: The perfect أَفْلَحَ predicates achieved success of whoever performs the causative/intensive زَكَّىٰهَا upon the pronominal object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purity and rectitude are actively produced, while falāḥ names attainment that remains in good; the action is therefore both corrective and durative.

activation_trace.role: Success as attainment, rescue, and lasting good makes the predicate a durable result rather than a passing win.
Purity and rectitude supply the direct transforming operation performed upon the pronominal object.

changed_reading.after: Whoever actively brings the pronominal object into rectitude has already entered a success characterized by continuance in good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَفْلَحَ and زَكَّىٰهَا join a root of cleaving/tillage to a causative verb whose root includes growth and increase.
baseline_models.mechanism: A compacted medium is opened like soil, then cultivated so that its own capacity can increase; success is the emergence made possible by that work.

activation_trace.role: Cleaving or opening supplies the first material operation: making passage through what was closed.
The tiller who splits ground turns opening into deliberate cultivation rather than mere rupture.
Growth, increase, and thriving provide the cultivated response that makes the opening successful.

changed_reading.before: Purification removes an impurity from a passive object.
changed_reading.after: Purification is cultivation: opening a viable field and drawing its latent capacity into growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative زَكَّىٰهَا can activate the root's fittingness branch alongside أَفْلَحَ as attained, lasting good.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agent succeeds by making the pronominal object apt for its proper work; rectitude is functional fit, not only spotless condition.

activation_trace.role: Suitability and fittingness turn purification into calibration for a fitting condition or use.
Attaining the aim and remaining in good make successful functioning the test of that calibration.

changed_reading.after: The object is made fit to realize and sustain its proper capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence presents illumination, construction, fertile extension, a living self, and its completion as coordinated making operations. The focus action becomes their human-scale continuation: the self is a made world whose viable ground must in turn be cultivated.

activation_trace.role: The tiller splitting ground supplies the human cultivation operation that answers the preceding acts of world-making.
Growth and increase make the self's flourishing the product sought by that cultivation.
Polishing and bringing to clarity contribute a preparatory operation that makes a formed thing effective and manifest.
Building by joining parts supplies a constructive mechanism rather than a merely decorative cosmic image.
Soft, fertile, growth-bearing earth gives the cultivation model a receptive material substrate.
Spreading and extending provide the preparation of room in which cultivation can operate.
The life-bearing self resolves the focus pronoun's near context and identifies the living field under cultivation.
Integrity and completion describe the self as formed capacity, ready for the distinct work of cultivation.

structural_cues: Verses 91:3-7 repeatedly pair a domain with an operation ending in the feminine singular object suffix, and 91:9 reuses that suffix.
The sequence culminates in نَفْسٍ immediately before the paired capacities of 91:8 and the focus result of 91:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies polishing, construction, fertile ground, spreading, a living self, and completion; I infer that their ordered recurrence makes زَكَّىٰهَا a continuation of constructive world-making. A live alternative is that the cosmic sequence frames the claim as oath evidence without supplying its mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The focus states an isolated rule of private purification.
changed_reading.after: The person continues a cosmic sequence of making by cultivating the formed self as a small living world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation, covering, diagnostic visibility, failed ignition, and secret insertion recast purification as bringing capacity into workable visibility. Cleaving opens; polishing discloses; concealment prevents the latent spark from becoming an achieved life.

activation_trace.role: Cleaving and opening supply the focus-side passage from closure to exposure.
Purity and rectitude name the disclosed condition without reducing the operation to surface cleaning.
Uncovering and appearance establish manifestation as an active transformation.
A covering that rises over and hides something supplies the reversible counter-operation to disclosure.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible sign by which a condition is recognized extends disclosure into diagnostic legibility.
A fire-striker that fails to kindle pictures latent capacity that never becomes operative.
Secret insertion or hiding supplies the immediate anti-operation that keeps the self's contents unworked and unlit.

structural_cues: Day's disclosure and night's covering are expressed as alternating operations upon the same feminine object suffix.
91:9 and 91:10 form a near-mirrored pair: achieved success with زَكَّىٰهَا versus failed attainment with دَسَّىٰهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovering, covering, a legible mark, failed kindling, and concealment; I supply the arrow that concealment blocks activation while purification makes latent contents available for work. The live alternative is a simpler moral opposition between cleansing and corruption with no epistemic layer.

changed_reading.before: Purification subtracts dirt from the soul.
changed_reading.after: Purification also uncovers and renders the soul's capacities legible, whereas failure hides them until their possible light cannot kindle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self is completed around a disclosed pair: expansive rupture and protective restraint. Successful cultivation differentiates these forces, opens channels for energy, and establishes safeguards; it need not mean amputating one half of the disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Cleaving makes discriminating channels and boundaries rather than indiscriminately destroying what is divided.
Growth makes viable increase, not mere suppression, the end of the internal regulation.
Fittingness contributes calibration of each capacity to an apt scope.
A middle, equitable, or just position supplies the regulating geometry between live capacities.
Wide splitting and outburst contribute expansive force that can open a channel or exceed it.
Warding off harm supplies the protective boundary paired with expansive force.

structural_cues: 91:8 coordinates فُجُورَهَا and تَقْوَىٰهَا as two disclosed possessions of the same self.
The focus follows immediately and retains the same feminine pronominal object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a completed self, an eruptive opening, and a protective barrier; I infer that cultivation governs their threshold relation so that energy becomes growth. The live alternative is that the pair is exclusively moral, requiring rejection of one and acquisition of the other.

changed_reading.before: Purification succeeds by deleting the wicked capacity and retaining only restraint.
changed_reading.after: Purification can be read as skilled threshold-work: differentiating expansive drive, channeling it, and fitting protective limits so the whole self can grow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later narrative externalizes inner regulation as collective handling of force and shared life-support: overflow becomes mobilized agency, contests a watering share, severs an animal's movement, and ends in eradication. The focus cultivation therefore acquires social and ecological fruit.

activation_trace.role: The ground-splitting tiller links personal success to stewardship of a field that sustains more than the isolated agent.
Growth and thriving make preservation of shared life a visible fruit of self-cultivation.
Rising water and overwhelming force materialize transgression as energy that has exceeded its banks.
Stirring what was still into motion turns latent excess into an acting social agent.
An allotted share of watering and its channel supply the concrete common resource whose limit must be honored.
Hamstringing an animal's legs converts ungoverned force into the disabling of another living body's movement.
Total eradication supplies the terminal collapse opposite to growth and lasting success.

structural_cues: The singular whoever/self pair of 91:9-10 is immediately followed by a collective historical subject and an individual's mobilization within it.
The narrative moves causally from denial and excess through a disputed watering allocation to bodily disabling and collective destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, mobilization, a watering share, hamstringing, and eradication; I infer that inner cultivation is tested by how power handles shared conditions of life. A live alternative is that the narrative is only an external cautionary example and does not specify the social content of زَكَّىٰهَا.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns a private interior achievement.
changed_reading.after: Self-cultivation proves itself publicly in bounded power, protection of shared sustenance, and refusal to disable another life for collective desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated equalizing root appears both in the self's formation and beside eradication. This makes equalization ambivalent: successful fitting must preserve differentiated life and growth, not merely make everything level.

activation_trace.role: Suitability and fittingness retain calibration as a live focus operation.
Growth supplies the criterion that distinguishes life-serving fit from sterile uniformity.
Integrity and completion present equalization first as constructive formation of the self.
Making things equal beside the destruction sequence introduces leveling as a potentially terminal operation.
Eradication fixes the destructive pole against which mere leveling must be tested.

structural_cues: The same form سَوَّىٰهَا occurs at 91:7 in the self's formation and at 91:14 after the destruction clause.
Both occurrences share the feminine suffix while their local sequences pull constructive and destructive possibilities apart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive completion, later equality, and eradication; I infer that growth is the discriminator between fitting and flattening. The live alternative is that the two occurrences have separate referents and no deliberate contrast beyond lexical repetition.

changed_reading.before: Making the self fit means smoothing it into balance.
changed_reading.after: Successful fitting preserves a differentiated capacity to grow; equalization that merely flattens life belongs to the opposite pole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window opens a temporal pattern of one light following another and closes on aftermath, residue, and consequence. This activates the lasting-good branch of success: cultivation is judged by the trajectory and trace it leaves, not by an intense instant.

activation_trace.role: Success with continuance in good makes endurance intrinsic to the focus predicate.
Growth supplies an unfolding process whose truth appears over time.
Following and succession establish continuity from one phase into the next.
The end and consequence of a thing make aftermath an explicit horizon of evaluation.
A remaining trace or residue asks what the cultivating action leaves behind.

structural_cues: The opening celestial sequence includes one body following another, while the final ayah explicitly names the aftermath.
Both أَفْلَحَ and زَكَّىٰهَا are perfect verbs, but their branch interaction can describe a result whose durability must still be visible in what follows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, growth, consequence, and residue; I infer that دوام الخير is tested by the after-pattern produced by cultivation. A live alternative is that celestial following and final aftermath frame the surah temporally without redefining the focus success.

changed_reading.before: The focus certifies a completed moment of purification.
changed_reading.after: The focus certifies a cultivation whose success is its maintained trajectory and the viable trace it leaves in later action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pair/even-number branch of ز ك و is form-distant from the ordinary causative reading and should not be offered as a lexical translation. It remains anchored because the focus uses that root immediately after the self is presented with two coordinated capacities, while cleaving and equitable positioning supply differentiation without erasure; downstream prose should call this a structural resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: زَكَّىٰهَا carries a root branch of pairing/evenness, while أَفْلَحَ carries cleaving; together they can imagine a differentiated pair made workable.

activation_trace.role: Pairing and evenness supply the odd but explicit root image of two terms held in relation.
Cleaving supplies differentiation of the pair without requiring destruction of either member.
Equality or equivalence gives the two disclosed capacities a relational geometry.
Expansive rupture supplies one force in the context's explicitly coordinated pair.
Protective warding supplies the counter-force in that coordinated pair.

changed_reading.before: Purification makes the self good by removing one of its two disclosed capacities.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, purification makes a cleft but workable pair: expansive and protective capacities become distinguishable, proportioned, and governable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pre-dawn-meal sense of falāḥ and the forenoon-food branch are materially remote from the focus proposition, so this is not a claim that أَفْلَحَ means eating. Their shared nourishment-and-timing image remains anchored to focus growth and suggests a non-punitive mechanism; downstream prose should render it only as an analogy of replenishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines a falāḥ branch that preserves a faster's strength with the growth branch of زَكَّىٰهَا.

activation_trace.role: The pre-dawn meal called falāḥ contributes timed nourishment that preserves strength for a continuing discipline.
Growth and increase turn nourishment into a model of sustaining viable development.
Forenoon food and early grazing echo nourishment at a marked phase of the daily cycle.

changed_reading.before: Purification works chiefly by deprivation and subtraction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, self-cultivation also feeds the strength needed for sustained growth at the right rhythm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sales-puffing branch of ف ل ح is a negative, derivationally distant branch and cannot replace the direct success predicate. It remains useful because deceptive winning and explicit falsehood recur in context, allowing the emphatic focus claim to function as a certification of genuine growth; downstream prose should present this as an anti-counterfeit shadow, not an alternate translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَفْلَحَ itself carries a branch of manipulated appearance in exchange, while its pairing with زَكَّىٰهَا can discriminate real thriving from a manufactured win.

activation_trace.role: Sales puffing, false speech, and deception supply the possibility of success manufactured as an appearance.
Purity and rectitude provide the focus-side criterion separating genuine success from its counterfeit.
Gambling and victory by deception supply a contextual image of winning without durable good.
Direct contradiction of truth makes counterfeit evaluation a consequential contextual act.

changed_reading.before: Any visible win can be called success.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the emphatic claim certifies only the win that produces real rectitude and growth, excluding manipulated or falsely advertised success.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from static moral cleaning to an agricultural mechanism: opening, cultivating, and drawing a formed self into growth.
The reveal-cover-bury sequence made purification an act of rendering latent capacities visible and workable, not merely removing contamination.
The paired expansive and protective capacities activated a threshold model in which self-cultivation channels force and fits safeguards rather than simply amputating one side.
The later water-share and hamstringing sequence gave private self-cultivation a social-ecological test, while the final aftermath made durable consequence part of success.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from crossing the focus roots' material branches—cleaving, tillage, growth, fittingness, and lasting good—with the window's repeated operations on a feminine object. This preserved several coexisting models: purification, cultivation, disclosure, calibrated force, public stewardship, and durable aftermath. Form-distant branches also exposed live but contained resonances of pairing, nourishment, and counterfeit success.
remaining_uncertainties: Focus-only syntax leaves the feminine pronoun unresolved; the immediate context strongly supplies the self, while the repeated suffix across cosmic objects may also sustain an analogical chain rather than a single referent.
The non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping sharpened diagnostic visibility, but it may be a productive mapping resonance rather than a semantic force in the source occurrence.
The constructive versus destructive force of the two سَوَّىٰهَا occurrences depends on their local referents and syntax; the contrast is strong as pattern but not compulsory as a single mechanism.
Pair/evenness, timed nourishment, and counterfeit success remain exploratory branch activations and should not be promoted to direct lexical translations.
